outgoing.name: Africa
outgoing.excerpt: Ringed Plovers are migratory and winter in coastal areas south to Africa.

outgoing.name: Canada
outgoing.excerpt: The Ringed Plover's breeding habitat is open ground on beaches or flats across northern Eurasia and in arctic northeast Canada.

outgoing.name: Europe
outgoing.excerpt: Some birds breed inland, and in western Europe they nest as far south as northern France.

outgoing.name: France
outgoing.excerpt: Some birds breed inland, and in western Europe they nest as far south as northern France.

outgoing.name: Great Britain
outgoing.excerpt: Many birds in Great Britain and northern France are resident throughout the year.
